purpose: Maquette exploratoire ; comparaison avant tout nouveau code
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE very high fidelity portrait iPhone app screen for O Mas La, a French mobile app to find moving carnival groups in Guadeloupe. This is a proposed visual mockup, not a screenshot of a real app. Full screen flat UI artwork at a tall phone viewport aspect ratio about 9:19.5, 1080x2340 if possible. No perspective, no hands, no device bezel, no surrounding presentation board, no title outside the screen. The entire interface is legible and complete, with real iOS status bar at top and safe area/home indicator at bottom.
Native iOS navigation visual language: restrained crisp system sans type, precise optical spacing, translucent material only for floating map controls, matte white sheet, deep navy ink #172033, muted slate labels #5E697A, blue #1765E8 primary action, green live indicator. Daylight legibility. Professional navigation-product finish.
Map stays visible and spatially coherent around Pointe-à-Pitre, a stylized but convincing coastal street map with pale warm gray city blocks, fine white streets, light aqua water west/south and subtle green squares. Small map labels “Pointe-à-Pitre”, “La Darse”, “Place de la Victoire”. Avoid inventing an exact route, ETA, distance, heading or future path. The selected group is located on a street, not in water, with a crisp blue anchored pin reading “Tambour bleu”; two quiet secondary group pins “Brise” and “Soleil orange”. No car icon. Keep all pins above the sheet and clear of other controls. Map branding and provider logo are absent because this is an illustrative mockup.
The selected group information, in every composition, must show exact French content: “Tambour bleu”, green dot then “En direct”, “Référent GPS · il y a 20 s”, main button “Rejoindre ce point”, small note “Vers la dernière position connue.”. Search placeholder exact “Chercher un groupe”. The app name “O Mas La” appears once, small. A discreet label “Démo · positions fictives” identifies illustrative content. Account is optional via a small outlined person icon. No login wall, no star rating, no number of members, no favorite feature, no invented event schedule, no declaration button while the group is live. Use consistent native outlined icons, not emoji. Accurate French accents. Do not replace the task with a dashboard or promotional poster. No decorative gradients, no cards nested inside cards.
COMPOSITION A — One lower sheet, thumb-friendly and immersive.
The top two thirds of the screen is calm uninterrupted map, with small O Mas La at top left below status bar, person button top right, two vertically stacked 44pt map control buttons on the right just above the sheet. The bottom roughly 34% is a single continuous white draggable sheet with generous 30pt upper corners. Within it in order: subtle centered drag handle; inset pale gray search field across almost the width; group title with close button on same row; inline live state and source-age; full width solid blue Rejoindre ce point button; small note below. This is one unified sheet, not two independent cards. Search and detail belong to the same thumb zone, with restrained hierarchy and no oversized display type. Main focal moment is the selected pin in the open map connected conceptually to the title in the sheet.
referenceKind: Composition native inspirée des visuels officiels consultés, sans reproduction d'une capture

edits.prompt: Edit this exact mobile UI mockup with one narrowly scoped correction: remove the decorative colored feather/fan logo immediately left of the words O Mas La at the upper left, replacing its area with a seamless continuation of the existing map water background. Keep the O Mas La wordmark as plain text, at the same baseline, and keep everything else pixel-compositionally unchanged: map framing and street geography, all pins, group names, search inside the lower sheet, selected group information, colors, type, button text, safe areas and portrait dimensions. Do not add another logo, mascot, tropical ornament, new text or new controls. This is an unapproved UI composition mockup, not a brand redesign.
edits.scope: Retrait de symboles décoratifs non demandés ; composition conservée.

approval: Marvin : A — Recherche et fiche dans un seul panneau bas (recommandé)
